 assertion:
 type: object
 description: >-
 The rule an `assert` step checks (
`kind: assert`). NOT a narrower\n spelling of a case's `checks`: this is `WidgetAssertion |\n Predicate`, an
d that union is why the field is called an assertion\n rather than a check. A `Predicate` is evaluated against the\n
PERSISTED transcript, so a stored run can be re-graded against it\n months later; a `WidgetAssertion` is evalu
ated against a LIVE DOM\n and can never be replayed. Calling this a check would promise the\n replayability

only one half of it has.
 additionalProperties: true
 additionalProperties: true
 RequestedModelSelection:
description: >-\n What a store-once row holds as its ONLY copy of the model: a full\n `ModelSelection` (`hosted`
runs on MCPJam credits, `org` on an\n organization connection, `local` on a key on the caller's machine) or a\n STO
RED `LegacyModelSelection` (own key only). Wherever one sits beside a\n model id (`modelId`, `model`), that id is COMPUTED
from it on reads, and\n accepted on writes as a shorthand the platform converts. A row with\n neither is an unlabell

ed old row and runs exactly as it always has.

 - $ref
